message: The other day, as I was watching the weather report with my cup of tea, I realized I had finally become the person who was ready for a storm. I had a stash of candles, batteries, and even a few snacks hidden away—no more scrambling at the last minute like I used to. It felt nice to be the one with a plan for once, instead of playing catch-up. Have you ever found yourself surprisingly prepared for something unexpected?
